title: agathosma crenulata
intro: Agathosma crenulata, commonly known as the Round-leaved Cape Chamissa, is a plant species native to the Western Cape Province of South Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Agathosma crenulata include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Agathosma crenulata are also attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit hepatoprotective and cardioprotective effects.
